fields.Name: Integration Test: RLS Scoped Reader
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role. Grants read on 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' SCOPED to the caller's own UserID (via the 'UI: Own AI Agent Runs' Row-Level-Security filter, UserID = '{{UserID}}') and grants nothing else — so a user whose ONLY role is this one is genuinely RLS-scoped (non-exempt), unlike internal users who also hold Developer/Integration and are RLS-exempt. Used by the rls-isolation integration suite (IT06) to prove multi-user cache + row isolation deterministically instead of skipping on databases that only have exempt admins. Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-rls-* test accounts.
